title: OFM render.json
description: Array of pixel-rendering rules consumed by georender. Each rule paints a texture or scatters a point asset under a set of conditions.

asset.description: Filename of the texture or point sprite relative to the assets dir (e.g. 'Grass_D_01.jpg', 'Lantern_Metal_Brass_F1_1x1.png').

type.description: Rendering primitive. texture = tiled fill; point = scattered sprite; line = stroked path.

weight.description: Z-order / priority within the renderer. Lower = behind. Negative numbers are conventional for backgrounds.

condition.description: Terrain/feature class names this rule applies to. Prefix with '-' to subtract. Empty/absent = always applies.

blur.description: Gaussian blur radius in pixels applied after rasterizing this rule.

generate.description: If true, scatter `asset` randomly within `generate_area` instead of placing at a feature centroid.

generate_area.description: Class names defining the area within which to scatter. Prefix with '-' to exclude.
